name: source-analysis
description: Read C and C++ sources as text, without a compiler, and extract functions failing closed to unparsed regions; measure per-function complexity and gate it like an assertion with thresholds, a baseline and reasoned suppressions; its own tests, fixtures and adoption example.
rationale: A lexical heuristic gate is a development diagnostic, not a security boundary: it never edits or runs the analysed code and reports what it could not read instead of guessing. Its fixtures are deliberately malformed C++ and belong with the analyser, not with the contract tests.
